# CanvasElement

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A leaf element that exposes the raw ICanvas for freeform drawing. The handler receives (canvas, width, height) and can use any ICanvas method including the path-building, transform, and clipping APIs.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new CanvasElement(Action<ICanvas, float, float> drawHandler)
```

## Properties

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Alt text for the canvas content (makes it a Figure instead of Artifact).
- [`DrawHeight`](#drawheight): Fixed height for the canvas element in points.
- [`DrawWidth`](#drawwidth): Fixed width for the canvas element in points.
- [`IsDecorative`](#isdecorative): When true, tagged as /Artifact regardless of AltText.
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`.

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alt text for the canvas content (makes it a Figure instead of Artifact).

### `DrawHeight`

```csharp
float DrawHeight { get; set; }
```

Fixed height for the canvas element in points.

### `DrawWidth`

```csharp
float DrawWidth { get; set; }
```

Fixed width for the canvas element in points. `0` (the default) fills the available content width; a positive value fixes the width and is clamped to the space available.

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; set; }
```

When true, tagged as /Artifact regardless of AltText.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.
